Uses group_partial_r2 compute joint R2 values. kd, ky Numeric vectors benchmark multipliers: omitted variable assumed kd times strong benchmark explaining treatment ky times strong explaining outcome. kd defaults 1 (exactly strong benchmark) ky kd. vector several values gives one row results per value ("kd sweep"). q, alpha Numeric: proportion effect explained away (passed sensemakr) significance level bootstrap confidence interval (default 0.05). r2dz.x, r2yz.dx Optional manual partial R2 values omitted variable treatment outcome (instead benchmark). bound_label Character label bounds table. reduce Logical: omitted variable reduce absolute value estimate (default TRUE)? bounds_row Integer: row sensemakr's bounds table use single kd supplied (default 1). reps Integer: bootstrap replications (default 1000). seed Integer NULL. seed set unless one supplied, results vary run run without . cluster Column name(s) vector cluster bootstrap. Length 1 (e.g. "firm") gives one-way cluster bootstrap percentile CIs. Length 2 (e.g. c("firm", "year")) triggers two-way cluster bootstrap using Cameron, Gelbach & Miller (2011) subtractive variance estimator: three bootstraps run (dimension intersection) combined V = V_G + V_H - V_(G n H). CIs p-values two-way case use normal approximation estimate +/- z * SE.
